title: Police department helicopter
summary: The police chief said on August 5, 2025 that the police helicopter helped fight fires three times in the past week. In January 2025 the council passed Bill 4 on first reading, adding $450,000 for helicopter operations, after voting 9 to 0 in October 2024 to move $350,000 for a helicopter hoist. The police chief has said an RFP would be used and the helicopter could arrive a year to a year and a half after a contract is awarded.
